metadata.description: Assigns Microsoft Foundry built-in Azure Policy controls for agents, models, tools and agent safety at subscription or resource group scope.
Effect for controls that can block requests.
Audit (default), Deny or Disabled.
Only these agent kinds are allowed, for example ["prompt", "hosted", "workflow"]. Empty = not assigned.
These agent kinds are denied, for example ["external"]. Empty = not assigned.
Hosted agents may only use these images, for example ["contoso.azurecr.io/*"]. Empty = not assigned.
Hosted agents may not use these images, for example ["docker.io/*"]. Empty = not assigned.
Agent kind and hosted-agent container image controls.
Audit (default), Deny or Disabled.
Approved model publishers, for example ["OpenAI", "Microsoft"]. Use the publisher name from the model card.
Approved model asset IDs or prefixes, for example ["azureml://registries/azure-openai/models/gpt-4.1/"]. Matched with "contains".
Block models whose lifecycle status is Preview.
Only allow models that are distributed directly from Azure.
Model deployment controls.
Audit (default), Deny or Disabled.
Approved tool types, for example ["web_search", "file_search", "code_interpreter"]. Adding "mcp" approves every MCP server.
Approved MCP server URLs. Case-insensitive; one "*" per value, for example "https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp*".
Approved MCP connector IDs.
Denied tool types, for example ["browser_automation", "browser_automation_preview"].
Denied MCP server URLs, for example ["https://mcp.example.com/*"].
Denied MCP connector IDs.
Tool controls for agents and toolboxes.
Assign the agent prompt content filter policy. Default: false.
Audit (default) or Disabled. This policy does not support Deny.
Prompt content filter that must be enabled and blocking. Default: Jailbreak.
Agent entity kinds evaluated by the policy. Default: ["prompt", "hosted"].
Agent safety: audit that agents keep a required prompt content filter on. Audit-only.
Major-version selector: 1.*.*-preview for preview built-ins, 1.*.* for GA built-ins.
One planned policy assignment.
